Class Manager

java.lang.Object
frontend.Manager
public class Manager extends Object
The manager view: the logo and Logout button along the top, buttons on the left for each page, and the selected page in the middle. This class only builds the window and switches between pages. Each page lives in its own file: ManagerOrderHistory, ManagerProductUsage, ManagerEmployeeData, ManagerInventory and ManagerCashierView. The helpers they share (database access, forms, table style) are at the bottom of this file.

    • lockTables

      static void lockTables(Connection conn, String tables) throws SQLException
      Locks tables (e.g. "inventory, menu_item") until the transaction ends. Used before checking something and then changing it (picking the next id, filling the last spot in a role) so two managers doing it at the same time can't both succeed.
      Parameters:
      conn - the database connection
      tables - the tables to lock, comma-separated
      Throws:
      SQLException

    • nextId

      static int nextId(Connection conn, String table) throws SQLException
      Returns the id one past the highest id in the table (1 for an empty table). The ids aren't generated by the database, so lock the table first so two managers can't get the same id. Used by all pages when inserting a new row.
      Parameters:
      conn - the database connection
      table - the name of the table
      Returns:
      the next available id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs
